purpose: event-driven autonomous scheduler with per-task live-carrier isolation

execution_worker.interactive_behavior: deprecated-global-mode; inspect per-task runtime carrier before claim/Phase-B

watchdog.interactive_behavior: deprecated-global-mode; remain available for unrelated autonomous tasks

invariants: Owner-active live runtime is the preferred carrier for the specific authorized task/chain it is carrying
GitHub remains the durable inter-agent handoff surface in both interactive and autonomous execution
a fresh per-task live carrier blocks scheduler execution only for that task/chain
Owner presence never globally disables, parks, or delays Broker/Worker
unrelated tasks without a fresh live carrier remain autonomously schedulable
an expired live carrier may fall back to scheduler when fallback_after_expiry=true
an explicit per-task hold blocks only that task without expiry
one worker invocation executes at most one target-agent task
active gateway lease prevents a second target-agent execution
phase A and phase B remain separate autonomous worker invocations
execution worker never schedules itself and preserves its hourly RRULE
only wake-broker-watchdog arms the execution worker
direct Owner-agent conversations do not use scheduler transport
